digest.component_or_area: code-review batch runner and gate dispatch
propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner.run iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion_id, causing activated project criteria to never enter Round A/B

Project criteria must be assembled at gate_dispatch.py construction point by querying registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing for active LLM-tier project entries and resolving physical prompts
CodeReviewBatchRunner must accept project_criteria tuple and inject entries only when req.step_id == 'round_a', never in round_b, ensuring exactly once-per-review execution
Project criterion findings must preserve model-emitted criteria tags and append logical criterion_id while retaining physical reviewer_id provenance
Missing or malformed project criterion prompt must raise a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path rather than silently degrading
